answers.core:
With the new TileMap functionality in 4.0, it is a great time to tweak and modify it in 4.1 and so-on, because the new functionality is still fresh and will likely change based on community input in the coming few years anyway.

This is also not a whole new feature, but simply a slight extension to an existing feature, which makes it ideal for the code engine rather than some tiny third-party plugin.
answers.workaround:
There are ways to use code to get around this. You can simply use integers, and then have some code that maps integers to their values/logic (switch statements, dictionaries/arrays, etc.).

However there are issues with this:

1. Integers in the editor do not tell you what they mean, so you'll need to reference what integer to pick by looking at the code or documentation.
2. Integers have (effectively) no limit, while enums can easily limit input to a select few values.
